name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited at a young age, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he started his career in a junior formula team, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his keen eye for detail and ability to translate data into tangible performance gains. Ricardo's approach to technical direction emphasizes a holistic understanding of the car, focusing on maximizing the synergy between all components.

He joined PEX Motorsport three years ago, initially as a senior engineer, and was recently promoted to Technical Director. Ricardo distinguishes himself with his collaborative leadership style, fostering a culture of open communication and continuous improvement within the team. He believes that a strong team dynamic is just as crucial as technical prowess in achieving success on the track. He aims to develop a technical strategy that will allow PEX to compete with bigger teams with more resources.

physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a focused look and a warm smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct team meetings standing up to keep everyone engaged.
